## What this changes

## Checks

- [ ] `npm run check` and `npm test` pass from the repository root
- [ ] Web wallet checks pass (`npm ci`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run lint`, `npm run test`, `npm run build` in `apps/web`) if the web wallet changed
- [ ] No secrets, mnemonics, private keys or real recovery material are included
- [ ] Docs updated where the change affects them (see `docs/inventory.md` and `docs:affected`)

## Notes for the reviewer

Anything the reviewer should know: evidence, open questions, follow-ups.
